answer: An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 10 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. The signal counter is kept in sable and wharf makes public each threshold crossing. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that pays. Every extra alias adds 10 hours of verification and 30 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
